source_text: Ligna setim imputribilia — virtutes durantes. Byssus torta — castitas laboriosa. Singula mysteria ferunt si digne inspicias.
pass_a_gloss: Woods acacia incorruptible — virtues lasting. Linen twisted — chastity laborious. Single-things mysteries bear if worthily you-inspect.
pass_b_english: [[Acacia wood that does not rot >> Bible:Exodus 25:5]] figures lasting virtues. Twisted linen is chastity under labor. Each detail bears mystery if worthily inspected.
